configuration.deploymentSelector: the installing Slack workspace. Captured 2026-08-10 from an INTERNAL Slack app installed to the pome twin sandbox workspace, under a user token (xoxp) carrying every scope mcp.slack.com advertises in its protected-resource metadata (all 30).
configuration.whyNotReadOnly: Slack's MCP page lists its required scopes PER TOOL, and four of them are writes (chat:write, channels:write, reactions:write, canvases:write). A read-only grant would plausibly return a listing missing the vendor's write tools, and the lane would then report twin-slack's write tools as mcp-tool-twin-only — a CRITICAL asserting the twin invented a capability that really exists. The golden must describe what an examinee's agent sees. This deliberately overrides F-1329's original 'all three are read-scoped' criterion; the capture issues one tools/list and invokes no tool, and the grant was revoked immediately after.
configuration.matchesExaminee: 19 tools, which is exactly the count Slack's own MCP documentation states the server exposes.
